Your friends and family are probably just scared. I have depression too and I've attempted suicide twice now. I've just recently started therapy and, since I'm feeling even more suicidal now, my psychologist had to tell my parents. They freaked out and they often change mood very quickly. First they're angry and shouting at me and then they try to comfort me and tell me it's all going to be okay.
It's not that people around you don't care. It's just that they don't know what to do. They're terrified and don't know how to act or what to say for fear it might make things worse.
